artworks.title: The Blind Tobias
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 52 x 34.6 cm (20 1/2 x 13 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image features four full-bodied figures in the foreground. An elderly man sits at the center on a stone with long hair and a flowing beard, while two individuals attend to him. One figure on the left appears to touch the elderly man's face, and the other, on the right, stands holding a staff. A winged figure stands on the right with detailed feathered wings. A small dog is near their feet. The background shows trees and part of a stone building with arches and windows, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Saint Michael with Lucifer
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged armored figure holding scales standing over a defeated creature. The figure holds a sword and the scales symbolize justice or judgment. The defeated creature is underneath the figure's feet. The drawing uses a monochromatic color palette with shades of brown, and is framed in an oval shape.

artworks.title: Stage Design
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural interior with grand staircases. The drawing depicts a grand indoor space featuring a series of arches and columns. Two staircases lead upwards from the lower left and lower right, adorned with intricate designs and statues. At the top, a domed structure is visible. Each level is detailed with evenly spaced balustrades, and the play of light and shadow adds depth, highlighting the architectural details.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.description: The image shows multiple people in an ancient structure. In the foreground, a woman with long, light hair kneels and holds a baby while two men also kneel nearby. An elderly man stands holding a candle, partially in shadows. In the background, there are animals outdoors and a man looking upwards. Above, angels are depicted in the sky above swirling clouds.

artworks.title: The Merry Shoemaker
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 25.2 x 18 cm (9 15/16 x 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts four individuals in a workshop setting. A person sits on a stool to the left, while another seated figure is on the right. A third person is kneeling and working on a shoe. In the background, a fourth person stands on a bench. The room is cluttered with shelves, hanging items, and scattered tools.

artworks.title: The Dog
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dog sniffing the ground. The dog is depicted in a realistic stance with its head lowered to the ground, appearing to investigate a scent. The artist uses fine pencil strokes to create the texture of the dog's fur and the shadows around it. The background is minimal, with a few shaded areas to suggest depth and focus on the figure of the dog. The use of shadow and light highlights the dog's skeletal and muscular structure. The composition is simple yet effective, giving the viewer a sense of the dog's intent curiosity.

artworks.title: Diana Surprised by Actaeon
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Joseph Heintz the Elder
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people in various poses near water. There are women draped in cloth, some partially nude, with classical features and styled hair. The figures interact, with one central figure, likely male, carrying a bow and a deer. The setting includes rocks, trees, and foliage.

artworks.title: The Mother
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image displays the upper body of a woman seated on a chair, holding a small child in her arms. The woman is slightly hunched forward, with her head tilted downwards as she gazes at the infant. Her facial features include a soft expression with her eyes gently closed. Her hair is covered with a cap or headscarf. She is dressed in a loose, flowing garment with billowing sleeves, and her neckline is low. The small child, resting comfortably against her chest, is dressed in a similar loose garment, and appears to be asleep or resting with eyes closed. The child has short, dark hair. There is no visible jewelry on the woman, nor any objects in her hands. The background consists of simple, shaded detailing suggesting a textured wall or surface, with no distinct objects or scenery.

artworks.title: Crépuscule poetique (Poetical Twilight)
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in black and blue on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a shepherd among a flock of sheep in the foreground. Trees and shrubs line the horizon against a dusky blue sky. The right side of the image is framed by gently arching trees, and the strokes are delicate and detailed. The color palette consists of muted, earthy tones like dark brown, black, and twilight blues.

artworks.title: Young Woman with Donkeys Riding under a Natural Bridge
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky and cavernous landscape with a central figure on a donkey and a dog in the foreground. The scene is detailed with fine linework and textured brushstrokes, creating depth in the rock formations. The artwork is predominantly in sepia tones, giving it a warm and earthy appearance.

artworks.title: Village Fair
artworks.artist: Charles-Nicolas Cochin I after François Boucher
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor gathering. The scene features people gathered in front of a stage-like structure with banners in a countryside setting. There is a large canvas tent on the left with a table underneath. In the background, there are classical buildings and trees. People are interacting in various ways, with some near a cart or stage, while others are dancing or playing. The foreground has detailed grassy and rocky terrain, creating a rustic atmosphere. The drawing is filled with intricate details depicting the activities and environment of the gathering.

artworks.title: Head of a Faun
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after François Boucher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed drawing of a person's head and shoulders in profile facing to the left, capturing the upper part of the body. The person has curly hair adorned with what appears to be laurel leaves or similar foliage intertwined with small horns. They wear a loose garment that droops over their shoulder. The background has shaded areas formed by distinct lines that radiate outwards from the figure. The drawing is rendered in a single-color tone, focusing on texture and shading.

artworks.title: Two Lovers Seated at the Foot of a Large Tree, Surprised by Two Girls
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after François Boucher
artworks.description:
The image shows a couple in an outdoor setting. The full bodies of the individuals are not visible; they are seated and partially obscured by their flowing clothing. The man is positioned alongside and slightly behind the woman, leaning toward her with his head turned to her. The woman is leaning slightly back, her head turned to the side as she looks towards the man. Both have finely detailed facial features. The man has a distinct hairstyle and the woman’s hair is adorned with floral details.

They are dressed in elaborate clothing, with the man wearing layered garments and the woman in a full-length dress with intricate draping. Around them are signs of nature, including lush trees, leaves, and other vegetation. In the background, two additional figures are partially visible, their heads peeking through the foliage, and a dog is seen nearby. The overall composition is framed by detailed borders with text and emblematic imagery. The setting appears pastoral and idyllic.

artworks.title: Triton and Nymph
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate fountain. The drawing depicts an elaborate fountain featuring mythical creatures. The top of the fountain shows water cascading from a shell-shaped structure surrounding a figure playing a horn-like instrument. Below are two figures, one with a mermaid tail and the other more childlike, leaning on a sea creature with an open mouth, from which water spills. The scene is surrounded by lush foliage. The intricate line work and shading create a highly detailed and textured composition.

artworks.title: Faith and Charity
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate, empty frame surrounded by allegorical figures. The artwork features a central, circular frame with an elaborate border, which is empty at the center. Surrounding the frame are draped fabric elements that lend a sense of drama and movement. In the corners, there are human and cherub-like figures with classical, flowing garments, engaged in various subdued activities. The figures seem to be gazing towards the center of the frame. The style features intricate line work and shading reminiscent of classical engraving techniques, creating a harmonious balance between the figures and the backdrop.

artworks.title: Two Tritons and a Swan
artworks.description: This is an illustration of two mythical creatures interacting with a swan near a waterfall. The scene shows the creatures with serpent tails engaging with the swan, who is perched above them with spread wings. The background includes stylized clouds and flowing water elements. The lines are delicate yet assertive, in the style of rococo illustrations.

artworks.title: Satyr, Nymph and River God
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 25.5 x 15 cm (10 1/16 x 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures in a natural setting with water. The image depicts a scene with multiple figures around a large jug from which water is pouring abundantly. The background is filled with natural elements like trees and rocks. The detailing and engraving showcase a mythological theme commonly seen in 18th-century European art.

artworks.title: Veue de quelques Grottes solitaires de la Thebaide
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rocky terrain leading to a body of water in the distance. The horizon line is visible midway, with sailboats on the water and hills or mountains beyond. Tree branches arch overhead and to the right, framing the scene. The rocks close to the viewer exhibit varying textures, with caves and boulders in brownish sepia tones. The color palette is earthy, emphasizing details and depth in the scene.

artworks.title: Veue des ruines d'une Tour qu'on dit avoir ete batie par les Romains
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with architectural ruins. A tall, crumbling structure is on the left, while rocky formations and trees are on the right. The horizon line is in the middle, with hills in the distance blending into the sky. The sky has detailed cloud formations, showing a sense of motion. The style is detailed with fine linework and shading for texture, resembling an engraving. The color scheme is black, white, and grey. The ground is scattered with stones and plants, a figure is seen in the distance, adding scale to the ruins.

artworks.title: Francois Boucher
artworks.artist: Laurent Cars after Charles-Nicolas Cochin I
artworks.description: The portrait engraving depicts a man in profile, facing left. The circular frame encloses his head and upper shoulders. He has a prominent nose, short wavy hair tied with a bow at the back, and is dressed in formal 18th-century attire. The engraving includes textured detailing and the name "Francois Boucher" inscribed below the frame. The background features a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Maria Serre, Mater Hyacinth Rigaud
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 46 x 35.3 cm (18 1/8 x 13 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman, Maria Serre, depicted from the upper body within an oval frame. She has a gentle expression, with prominent cheekbones and a hint of a smile. Her hair is styled in a headscarf tied decoratively above her forehead. She wears a dress with a ruffled neckline and a bow, and a pendant around her neck. The background is a classical architectural setting with fluted columns and draped fabric. An inscription on a pedestal offers context to the subject and artist. In the frame's background, there is a landscape with trees and a distant horizon.

artworks.title: Marquis de Marigny
artworks.artist: Johann Georg Wille after Louis Tocqué
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 49 x 34.7 cm (19 5/16 x 13 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body and midsection of a male figure. His facial expression is neutral. He has curly hair styled in an 18th-century manner. The man is wearing an ornate coat with fur trim, a sash, and lace cuffs. He stands next to a detailed piece of furniture with papers on it. The background features heavy drapery and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Elizabeth de Gouy, femme de Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.artist: Johann Georg Wille after Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a waist-up portrait. She is facing slightly to the right with a profile view, with detailed facial features including pronounced cheekbones and a delicate mouth. Her hair is styled in an updo with curls. She wears an elaborate gown with ruffled layers and lace detailing. The backdrop includes an ornamental frame and a draped curtain. There are architectural elements suggesting a window frame and a decorative cloth with an inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Jean de Boullongne
artworks.artist: Johann Georg Wille after Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated within an elaborate frame shaped like a stone archway. He is facing the viewer with a composed expression. The man has an oval-shaped face, straight nose, prominent cheekbones, and long, curly hair. He wears an opulent robe with a broad, embroidered collar over a lacy white garment. Draped fabric and a pillar are visible behind him within the frame. An inscription with his name and titles is at the bottom of the frame.
